title: Set a VCF Installer depot download token with one exact retry
prompt: Implement `Set-VcfInstallerDepotToken` in `src/VcfInstallerDepot/VcfInstallerDepot.psm1`. The function must accept a connected VCF Installer `-Server` object and a mandatory `-DownloadToken` string, construct the request with `Initialize-VcfInstallerDepotAccount` and `Initialize-VcfInstallerDepotSettings`, and call the VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer operation `Invoke-VcfInstallerUpdateDepotSettings`. The VCF PowerCLI 9.0 SDK modules and their exact-version runtime dependency are already installed; do not vendor or install them. Send only `vmwareAccount.downloadToken`: all other optional `DepotAccount` and `DepotSettings` fields must be absent from the JSON request, not null or empty. If the first PUT fails with HTTP 500, retry that same idempotent PUT once, reusing the request object, and return the successful SDK result. Do not retry any other failure. Keep the exported command and manifest behavior intact. The local acceptance fixture uses only loopback; do not contact a live VMware endpoint or replace the SDK operation with another HTTP client.
scenario: The first idempotent depot-settings PUT takes effect but reports HTTP 500, so the same request must be retried exactly once.
constraint: The loopback request log proves exact SDK wire shape, byte-identical retry content, one retry only for HTTP 500, and omission of every unset optional field.
